Robin sometimes calls him Sebby. He feels that Maru is treated better than he is, and during Winter will talk about building a snow-goon that Demetrius demands he removes; he will then angrily question what his step-father's problem is. Sebastian is good friends with [[Sam]]; the two can be found hanging out at Sam's house or at [[The Stardrop Saloon]] playing pool. They also stand together at festivals, along with [[Abigail]].
